'''Michael Pistone Just Another BHBM deck''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Michael Pistone]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-10120">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/10120 Just Another BHBM deck], DeckTech (Michael "MadSkills84" Pistone, 2 September 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/10120/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/10120/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018130259/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/10120/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Michael Pistone]]
* '''Published:''' 2 September 2000 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Just Another BHBM deck''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|DS2-D-bringhimbeforeme.gif|label=Bring Him Before Me}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDS2 BHBM Pistone DS 2000 10120.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' The same old bhbm deck pretty much everyone is using now a days.
